title: [FEATURE] 🇵🇱 Expand curse words vocabulary with Polish language support
body:
I heard from LinkedIn about curse words tracking in Claude Code analytics.

I would like to formally raise a concern regarding the representation of the Polish developer community in this dataset.

The word "kurwa" is, by conservative estimates, the most frequently uttered word in software engineering across Central Europe. It transcends its literal meaning. In practice it functions as:

- A debugging breakpoint ("kurwa... wait, it works now")
- A senior engineer's code review shorthand
- The phonetic equivalent of a stack trace
- A unit of measurement for technical debt (e.g. "this module is about 7 kurwas deep")

Without tracking "kurwa", your curse word statistics are systematically undercounting developer frustration by approximately 38 million people. This is a data integrity issue.

For completeness, the following variants should also be considered:

| Term | Context |
|------|---------|
| `kurwa` | General purpose |
| `kurwa mac` | Enterprise/formal contexts |
| `ja pierdole` | Reserved for failed rebases and migration rollbacks |
| `szlag` | The PG-13 variant, suitable for pair programming |

Thank you for your consideration.
author: lucagentile
